appName:
NOVA ULTIMATE AI STUDIO — PROFESSIONAL AI FILM FACTORY

Build a complete, professional, mobile-first AI multimedia production studio called NOVA ULTIMATE AI STUDIO.

IMPORTANT: I do not want a static mockup, a gallery of images, or a fake application. I want a real working production platform.

1. AI ASSISTANT

- Intelligent conversational assistant.
- Answer questions.
- Write stories, scripts, dialogues and scenarios.
- Help create anime universes and characters.

2. ANIME PRODUCTION STUDIO

- Generate actual animated video sequences from text descriptions and scripts.
- Create characters with consistent appearances.
- Animate movements, expressions and actions.
- Generate voices, dialogue and sound.
- Create complete episodes with multiple scenes.
- Automatically assemble the scenes into a finished episode.

3. MANGA AND MANHWA STUDIO

- Create complete manga chapters.
- Create professional manhwa and webtoon episodes.
- Generate panels, dialogue, backgrounds and characters.
- Maintain character consistency throughout chapters.
- Export finished comic episodes.

4. AI FILM STUDIO

- Transform a complete screenplay into a movie.
- Generate multiple video scenes.
- Maintain continuity between scenes.
- Automatically organize the scenes.
- Add narration, dialogue, sound effects and music.
- Automatically edit and assemble the final film.
- Support projects lasting several minutes, 30 minutes, one hour or multiple hours through progressive rendering.

5. AUTOMATIC VIDEO EDITING

The user must not have to manually assemble individual images or clips.
The application must automatically:

- Arrange scenes.
- Synchronize audio and dialogue.
- Add transitions.
- Manage subtitles.
- Produce the final video.
- Export MP4 files.

6. REAL AI ENGINES

Integrate genuine video, image, voice and language AI services.
Use available free and open-source engines where possible.
Create a modular backend that supports real generation providers.
Never pretend that an operation succeeded when it did not.
Show honest generation progress and errors.

7. DESIGN

- Futuristic premium interface.
- Black, electric blue and purple.
- Atom-inspired AI application icon.
- French language by default.
- Fully responsive Android interface.
- Professional production dashboard.
- Project library and generation history.

8. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Build a complete functional application.
- Use a reliable backend for long-running video generation.
- Use job queues and progressive rendering.
- Save project progress.
- Protect API credentials.
- Do not put secret keys in frontend code.
- Provide graceful handling when a free service is unavailable.

9. FINAL DELIVERY

Build the actual application, not just a design.
Make every implemented button functional.
Create all necessary files.
Prepare a complete project that can be exported and deployed.
Explain how to obtain the project source and ZIP.
